specs.notes: Rev 1.0, 128x128B entries, primary@LBA1, backup@last, protective MBR@LBA0.
CRC32 (crc32fast=IEEE) on header and entry array.
Backup fallback only fires on CorruptTable (CRC). Corrupt primary signature returns NoPartitionTable and is propagated without trying backup; initialize_or_format then reformats destructively.
size_bytes=0 rest-of-disk supported.
>1 rest-of-disk rejected.
Overflow of fixed partitions rejected.
Protective MBR type 0xEE at LBA 0.
RFC 4122 v4 GUIDs; see unspecced urandom-failure fallback.
UTF-16LE encode/decode capped at 36 chars.
Configurable ns_id via set_ns_id and config.ns_id.
Sector size parameterized; no explicit 512/4096 validation.
initialize/format/partition_info/num_partitions provided.
block_device: IBlockDevice receptacle.
initialize_or_format returns (PartitionTable, formatted:bool).
Fixed set of sector writes independent of device size.
read_bytes does one ReadSync/recv per sector; entry array (16KiB=32 sectors @512B) plus header = 33 round-trips, not the specified <=2.
Round-trip offsets identical; no automated test.
CRC-corrupt primary falls back to backup; signature corruption does not (see FR-003). No test.
ASCII names preserved on round-trip; no test.
Dispatcher wires format_on_init -> initialize_or_format; false path avoids reformat.

unspecced.item: Hardcoded primary entry LBA on read
unspecced.notes: try_read_gpt_at(1,2) ignores parsed header.partition_entry_lba (gpt.rs:370); breaks reading externally-created GPTs. Low.
Non-random collision-prone GUID if urandom unavailable; only in Implementation Notes, not any FR. Low.

conflicts.description: SC-001/SC-002/SC-003 have no automated tests; plan.md and tasks.md confirm no test files exist and [dev-dependencies] is empty.
FR-003/US2 scenario 2 requires backup fallback for a 'corrupt primary', but only CRC corruption is covered; signature corruption is not.
